نمتدح (form VIII)
# نَمْتَدِحُ (namtadiḥu) /nam.ta.di.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
# نُمْتَدَحُ (numtadaḥu) /num.ta.da.ħu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
# نَمْتَدِحَ (namtadiḥa) /nam.ta.di.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
# نُمْتَدَحَ (numtadaḥa) /num.ta.da.ħa/:
